notes:

Made in Germany 78R 
Concert Played by - Odeon Concert Party

Audio Restoration by - Laszlo Hortobagyi, Budapest, Hungary
Disc Source Courtesy - Sunny's Museum of Discs & Machines, Kerala, India
=========================================================
Note from Sunny Mathew of Discs & Machines museum, Kerala , India
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Four South Indian languages..Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and ..Urdu and Hindi.
They are pre-Saraswathi Stores Odeon pressed in Germany.
 C.E.Woods were the Agents for Columbia and Lindstrom. 

South Indian records were issued on Black label Columbia (Pressed in UK) , Parlophon and Odeon labels were pressed in Germany , even though Columbia and Lindstrom had merged in 1926. Seethaphone, Banglore were the sole Agents for Odeon and Parlophon under Lindstrom and Dinkson for Columbia. Very few records were issued on Columbia, Odeon and Parlophon labels. 
Odeon and Parlophon records had matrix numbers in "Mad" series. (Mad.. Madras)

After the merger of Columbia/Lindstrom with Gramophone Company, Agencies were rearranged.. P.Orr controlling Columbia label (GE, LBE BEX, VE series), and Saraswathi stores controlling Odeon. Parlophon label was not used by Saraswathi stores.

The Gramophone Co., Ltd., Dum Dum
title: Sm. Padmavathi Shaligram* - Udara Vyragya
notes:
Canarese Devotional
Text on label in Roman, Urdu and Canarese

Audio Posted at - https://archive.org/details/n-8800-omh-5914-15-smt-padmavati-shaligram
Song title should be - Udara Vairagyavidu.
Please see also - https://www.discogs.com/Miss-Padmavathi-Shaligram-Uthara-Vyrgiya-/release/14685931

The song goes like this:
 
udara vairagyavidu
namma padumanabhanali lesha bhakuti illa

Udara - Stomach
Vairagya - Detachment
===============================================================
Rough translation:
This is a kind of detachment only for living (stomach is used in that sense).
There is not even a little Bhakti towards Padumanabha.

The next stanzas condemn all eternal acts like taking a dip in river but having qualities like jealousy inside

Phono-Violin - 
A phonofiddle is a class of stringed musical instruments that are played with a bow and use a phonograph type reproducer as a voice-box. The sound producing diaphragm may be a metal cone as in the Stroh violin or a mica sheet as in the instruments made by A. T. Howson, London and the Stroviols company of Britain. The sound generated by the vibrations from the string or strings are transferred through the bridge to a connecting arm into the center of the diaphragm within the reproducer. The vibrating column of air is then directed into one or several horns. (Source: Wikipedia)
